data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recognised net prior year reserve releases of GBP 11.1m in 2023 (a release of c.0.47% of opening gross claims reserves). Favourable development occurred across Cyber, Casualty (Professional Lines) and Energy, and the underwriting result benefited from lower large catastrophe losses in 2023. These favourable movements were partially offset by adverse development in the reinsurance book driven by a number of older year specific losses. Note: only a net prior year figure is explicitly stated in the report; gross prior year movement is not disclosed and the gross claims development triangle is affected by reinsurance-to-close activity, which complicates gross PYD measurement.

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net prior year reserve release of GBP 11.1m; no gross prior year movement figure is provided in a single gross movement note. A gross claims development triangle is present but is affected by reinsurance-to-close (RITC) activity (Syndicate 1861 2020 YOA closed into 4444 2021), which distorts gross triangle-based PYD calculations. Accordingly the prior year movement used above is the explicit NET figure from the report (flagged). Some LOB mapping (e.g. 'Marine & Energy') required judgment and carries reduced confidence.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the notes (page 25) but parsing the individual development-period rows reliably was not possible in this extraction. In addition, the triangle is distorted by RITC and LPT transactions noted in the report; therefore triangle-based PYD is unreliable without further manual reconciliation.
